newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse turnover on the rise.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse turnover on the rise.

text.p: Turnover on the Bucharest stock exchange climbed to 42.1 million lei on Tuesday from 29.7 million previously in stronger buying in fertiliser maker Azomures SA.
Shares traded mixed, with five stocks drifting higher, six touching new lows and one remaining unchanged.
Two unofficial indices slipped to year lows.
"Interest in Azomures was higher today but supply was a bit thicker sending its price down 100 lei," said a trader.
Azomures took 72 percent of total turnover and closed at 11,000 lei.
Demand for the other issues remained thin and four stocks had no trade.

"Considering the average 25 million lei in turnover at the past four sessions, today's level was high," another trader said. "But I don't think it will stay there next session, as investors start slipping into a holiday mood."
Syringe maker Sanevit SA remained suspended for the seventh consecutive session pending an announcement on decisions reached by a shareholders' meeting last month.

Two unofficial value-weighted indices -- the VAB, computed by Vanguard SA, and Bucharest Investment Group 's BIG -- fell to year lows. The VAB dropped 4.2 percent to 281.6 points and the BIG slipped 4.23 percent a 280.64 points.
